title: Users
lede: Accounts on this deployment with their status and recent activity. Metadata only.
listFailedHint: Check the connection and try again.
emptyFiltered: Nothing matches these filters. Clear the search or choose another status.
emptyAll: Accounts appear here once someone signs up.
privacy: Admins see account details and counts only. CVs, chats and documents are never shown here.

sheet.countsNote: Counts only. The content stays private.

action.suspendHint: Signs the user out everywhere and blocks login until you enable the account again.
action.enableHint: Lets the user log in again.
action.resetHint: The user gets an email with a link to choose a new password. You never see the password or the link.
action.deleteHint: Closes the account now and signs the user out. Their account, projects and documents are removed in the next cleanup. This cannot be undone.

locked.self: This is your account. Admin accounts cannot be suspended, reset or deleted here.
locked.admin: Admin accounts cannot be suspended, reset or deleted here.
locked.deleting: Deletion is in progress. The data is removed in the next cleanup.

done.delete: Deletion started for {{email}}. The account is closed now.

error.admin_target_forbidden: Admin accounts cannot be changed here.
error.confirmation_mismatch: The email you typed does not match this account.
error.account_deleting: This account is being deleted, so it cannot be enabled.
error.generic: That did not work. Try again.
